Company Profile
Tianjin Youfa International Trade Co., Ltd. is the subsidiary of Tianjin Youfa Group. As one of the windows for international business, we mainly focus on exploring overseas markets as well as developing and offering service for major domestic clients. Tianjin Youfa Group is a comprehensive steel-based enterprise, the business includes steel-making, steel strip, straight seam welded pipe, galvanized pipe, rectangular pipe, spiral pipe, plastic inner-lined pipe, seamless pipe, covered electrode, so on and so forth. The annual integrate production capacity amounts to 7.5 million tons. Since 2006, we have been one of the leading corporations in Chinese Top-500. What is more, Youfa Group is the largest straight-seam welded pipe manufacturer in China. In 2008, "YouFa" Brand was regarded as the "Well-known Chinese Trademark" by Trademark Office State Administration for Industry &Commerce of the People's Republic of China. Meanwhile, we are the first-class supplier for CNPC, Sinopec and some big relevant companies. So as to adapt to the overall-developing strategy, at the beginning of 2010, YouFa Group and its subsidiaries founded SIANO(Beijing) Steel Co., Ltd, which is responsible for the import &export business, building business contact with some influential companies and providing the after-sale service for our customers.
Our motto is "Integrity Is First, Clients are Highest" and we will do our utmost to provide the best service for customers both at home and abroad.
